A new leak reveals that one of the most popular watch faces on the Apple Watch—Modular—will gain several new color customization options in watchOS 27. Here are the details.

Modular watch face to receive new color customization options in watchOS 27

Apple is expanding the customization options for the Modular watch face in watchOS 27.

Modular has become a top choice for many users due to its exceptional flexibility and versatility. Beyond offering numerous complication slots, the watch face also allows users to personalize its appearance through a variety of different color options.

Aaron Perris recently discovered that iOS 27 beta 5 has revealed nine new Modular color options set to launch in watchOS 27.

However, this beta version does not yet showcase previews of these nine new colors. Nevertheless, Perris located the corresponding color names within the beta code.

Some of these new colors may preview the brand-new watch bands launching next month, namely for the Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4.

Additionally, Mark Gurman previously reported that Apple will introduce a brand-new Modular watch face inspired by Modular Ultra in watchOS 27.

Which watch face do you use most often? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
